name: woosmap-shopify
description: Monorepo: shared Woosmap libraries (packages/*) + Shopify apps (apps/*) — starting with checkout address autocomplete.

scripts.// build:libs: The apps resolve packages/* through their built `dist` (exports/types point there), so anything that reads them must build first. Without this, a fresh clone fails typecheck and — worse — an app's tests silently run against a stale engine.

// packageManager: Pins the pnpm everyone uses, CI included (pnpm/action-setup reads this field). Must stay >= 10.26: pnpm-workspace.yaml declares minimumReleaseAge, trustPolicy and blockExoticSubdeps, and an older pnpm ignores them silently, so an older pin would quietly disable the supply-chain hardening.
